name: line-sidebar
title: Line Sidebar
description: A vertical menu where each numbered label and its short tick react to pointer proximity, shifting right and turning purple. Clicking a row sets a lasting accent and grows the marker beside it.
use: A docs or app sidebar needs a compact, cursor-aware menu with a clear active page.
avoid: The proximity effect is pointer-only, so touch and keyboard users get no feedback from it.
a11y: Rows are plain list items with click handlers, so Tab never reaches them and there is no focus ring; aria-current marks the active row. (keyboard: no, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A narrow column of twelve small numbered labels, each preceded by a thin grey rule, evenly stacked on a black field. The active row is tinted purple and pushed right, and rows near it extend their ticks and brighten.
behaves: As the pointer moves down the list, rows within reach slide right, shift toward purple and stretch their tick marks like a fisheye. Clicking a row keeps it accented and lengthens the marker line beside it.
customise: Items, accent, text and marker colours, index and marker visibility, proximity radius, max shift, falloff, marker length and gap, tick scale, item gap, font size and smoothing are props.
weight: light: One rAF loop eases CSS variables on twelve short rows and stops when settled.
